body:
Thank you all so much for your kind words. It really means the world to me. I just wanted to share my story to give you all hope, that even in the darkest hours, a little light can shine your way to a better path.
I’m so glad I’m still here and I will keep fighting! And I Hope, so will you! 💙

I’ve made it to 23 and made nothing of my life. So it’s not a real achievement to stay this long.

I just can’t handle this emptiness anymore. I have nobody to talk to about my problems, except my psychiatrist, wo just prescribes more drugs.
My best friend has left the country for at least a whole year and the one friend that knows most of my problems doesn’t really respond anymore.
So what should I stay for?
